name: Inside bar breakout
description: Price action: trade the break of an inside bar in either direction, stop at the other side of it.

about.how_it_works: An inside bar has its whole range inside the previous candle (the 'mother bar'): the market is pausing and coiling. A close above the inside bar's high is a buy, and a close below its low is a sell. The stop goes at the opposite end of the inside bar, so the risk is small and clearly defined. The target is twice the risk.
about.works_best: Daily and 4-hour charts, especially after a strong move, where the pause resolves in the same direction.
about.fails_when: Choppy markets break out one way and reverse. Waiting for a close beyond the range, rather than a touch, filters some of those.
